summary: Radware Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 20, 2026, solely to announce its 2026 Annual General Meeting to be held on May 25, 2026, and to furnish the related notice, proxy statement, and proxy card. The meeting agenda includes the election of three Class III directors, approval of equity awards and bonus modifications for the CEO, and reappointment of auditors. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event described. This is a routine proxy circular for an annual meeting, not a special situation.
